items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: The interviewee addresses the interviewer as 'Dick' multiple times (e.g., 'He wouldn't play on it, Dick.', 'Well there's so many, Dick...'). There is no evidence of a professional musical relationship, only a conversational one.

ctx.x: Oh, thank you, Mr. Hollins. We were talking about the pianos and how he didn't want to... Right. ...dine's pose.
He wouldn't play on it, Dick. He was picky.
Yeah. And so you couldn't retune him, you just were there.
